item.subject: science
item.stem:
Priya is fixing a notice board at home. She presses a drawing pin into the board with her thumb. The pin has a broad flat head and a sharp pointed tip.

She pushes with a force of 20 N. The flat head has an area of 1 cm² and the pointed tip has an area of 0.01 cm².

Which statement about the pressure is correct?

options.A: Doubling the area of contact doubles the pressure for the same force.
options.B: The pressure on Priya's thumb and the pressure on the board are equal because the force is the same.
options.C: For the same perpendicular force, a smaller area of contact gives a greater pressure.
options.D: The sharp tip gives less pressure because it feels lighter on the board.
